## PRB1.3. Safety

-   In 2025, LPS SR achieved the planned maturity levels set out in its performance plan for all five components of the EoSM.

-   When looking ahead to the end of RP4 targets, LPS SR has already achieved 3 out of 5 EoSM targets, needing improvement in Safety Risk Management and Safety Promotion to reach the RP4 targets.

-   Slovakia has not included any airports in their RP4 performance plans, thus not reporting on runway incursions during the reference period.

-   The rate of separation minima infringements (SMIs) at State level was 5.45, and at ANSP level 2.72. Both indicators were below the Union-wide average. When comparing to 2024, rate of SMIs has increased at both State level and at ANSP level.
